summary: Innovation Ultimate bundles the base Innovation game with all five expansions plus a new Unseen expansion and a new Age 11, all streamlined for easier setup and play. The underlying experience is unchanged from base Innovation: fast, chaotic tech-tree racing full of card-driven attacks and reversals.
praised: all-in-one definitive edition with everything streamlined
new Age 11 content extends the arc into the near future
reworked expansions are easier to mix in than the originals
same enormous replay value as base Innovation
criticised: still has Innovation's steep learning curve for newcomers
expansions can add even more rules overhead once mixed in
large box/card count can be overwhelming to organize

interaction.kind: open tableau effects, forced exchanges, and direct attacks
interaction.detail: As with base Innovation, all tableaus are public and dogma effects let players constantly share, steal, or destroy each other's cards, with expansions adding further ways for players to affect one another's boards.

scoring.why: This omnibus keeps Innovation's core win condition of racing to claim enough Achievement cards via icon thresholds, with the added expansions and Age 11 offering more routes to those thresholds.
scoring.how_you_win: You play and use technology cards to build up icons of different colors and trigger their special abilities, spending resources to claim Achievement cards; the first player to collect enough Achievements wins immediately (or, if the deck runs out first, whoever has the most Achievements wins).
